result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is a spelling error in the search placeholder, a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, and a partially visible empty category chip at the screen edge. The cut-off pizza card at the bottom appears to be normal scroll behavior.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder text contains a typo: 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated by the screen edge without an ellipsis, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis to truncated titles or ensure card text wraps/truncates gracefully within visible bounds.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right of the chip row is partially visible but shows no label, appearing as an empty gray sliver.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or peek amount so the next chip shows part of its label, signaling scrollability without looking broken.

issues.description: The delivery promo banner's decorative circles overlap the text area slightly and the banner's right side looks visually unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Reposition decorative shapes so they don't crowd content, or reduce their opacity to keep the banner clean.
